questions.objective: 6.1 Recognize common caught-in or between hazards in construction
questions.text: Which condition is a common caught-in or between hazard on a construction site?

answers.text: A worker standing between a backing vehicle and a fixed wall
A marked walkway separated from equipment traffic
A guarded rotating shaft on a stationary machine
A trench protected with an appropriate protective system

explanations.a: Workers can be crushed when caught between moving equipment and fixed objects. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Answer boundary: separation from equipment traffic reduces caught-in or between exposure.
explanations.c: Guarding reduces exposure to moving parts.
explanations.d: Protective systems reduce cave-in and caught-in hazards.

questions.name: Focus Four: Caught-In or Between

questions.text: A worker reaches into a running mixer to clear material. What is the main hazard?

Being caught in moving parts
A chemical label issue only
A fall from a roof edge

explanations.c: Chemical information may matter, but the immediate hazard is moving machinery.
explanations.d: The described exposure is moving machinery, not a roof fall.
